product.text: the process of making instant noodles in a factory

st1.text: flour, water and salt are mixed together to make dough

st2.text: the dough is pressed into thin sheets by rollers

st3.text: the sheets are cut into wavy strands, which are then steamed for two minutes

st4.text: are fried in hot oil, and this frying removes the water

st5.text: the blocks are cooled by fans on a conveyor belt

st6.text: seasoning is added and the noodles are packaged in sealed packets

coaching.first: In the second part of the process, [Middle Point] was [Stage 4].
coaching.flagged: "was" is past tense. A process happens every time, so use the present simple, and let [Stage 4] carry its own verb.
coaching.fixed: In the second part of the process, [Middle Point] [Stage 4].

rating.summary: All seven stages are covered in order, with correct present simple passives and clear sequencers. The fixed sentences are long and repeat "process" and "step" often.
rating.strength: "the dough is pressed into thin sheets by rollers" is an accurate passive that names the equipment.

priority.text: Cut the repeated words in your frame ("of the process", "step") and link stages with "once" or "before being".
